reasoning: Read the whole packing path on both sides. TagFixWallGranPackExchange (fix_wall_gran_kokkos.cpp:368-381) does 'const int i = d_sendlist(mysend); int m = i*size_history; for (int v = 0; v < size_history; v++) d_buf(m++) = ...d_history_one(i,v);' -- the destination offset is derived from the LOCAL ATOM INDEX i, not from the send slot mysend. pack_exchange_kokkos returns 'nsend*size_history' (line 410), and comm_kokkos.cpp:1404 does 'MPI_Send(k_buf_send...data(), nextrasend, MPI_DOUBLE, ...)' i.e. it transmits exactly the first nsend*size_history doubles of the buffer; comm_kokkos.cpp:1371-1372 only guarantees 'nsend*fix_iextra->maxexchange' doubles of capacity. So the packed values land at arbitrary offsets up to nlocal*size_history (outside both the transmitted window and, in general, the allocated buffer). Both sibling implementations index by the send slot: fix_neigh_history_kokkos.cpp:383-385 'int m = nsend + offset; d_buf(mysend) = d_ubuf(m).d;' and fix_spring_self_kokkos.cpp:186-187 'int m = nsend + offset; d_buf[mysend] = m;'. Nothing compensates elsewhere -- the unpack side (line 422) also assumes slot-major layout ('int m = i*size_history'), which is only consistent with a slot-indexed pack.
fix: In operator()(TagFixWallGranPackExchange,...) replace 'int m = i*size_history;' with 'int m = mysend*size_history;'. (The atom index i must still be used for the d_history_one reads and for the d_copylist compaction.)
